## Reverse Mountain

The currents of all four Blues climb Reverse Mountain and meet at the summit. Every crew in the world funnels through that single channel.

Reach 2,500 Doriki and sail into the Grand Line. Expect company at the summit: everyone on the server comes this way.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Strongest of Your Blue](02_villains_of_the_blues.md#q-497f71c2917c479e)

**Tasks**

- Reach 2,500 Doriki
- Sail into the Grand Line

**Rewards**

- Doriki +360, Belly +15,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku

<a id="q-38abde8f9dec3fd0"></a>
